meta.title: UJG Color System v2.0
meta.heading: Urban Jungle Goddess — Color System v2.0
meta.lead: Locked Jul 29, 2026. Six core colors, each specified across ten value systems. Math systems (HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSB, HUE, LAB) are exact. RAL, Copic, HKS, and Prismacolor are nearest physical matches — verify on a fan deck before production.
meta.goldenRule: Golden Rule — Never use more than 3 colors in a single design element.
meta.note: On the physical-match systems: HEX, RGB, CMYK, HSB, HUE, and LAB are computed exactly from each hex. RAL, Copic, HKS, and Prismacolor are ink / marker / pencil libraries with no exact digital formula — the values shown are the nearest visual match and should be confirmed against a physical fan deck before any print, signage, or illustration run. CMYK is an uncoated naive conversion; for production, soft-proof against your printer's ICC profile.
meta.fidelity: Extracted verbatim from the reference HTML. Values are reproduced exactly as written, including the RAL / Copic / HKS / Prismacolor approximations.
